notes: figurehead-grapnel: curl/curl upstream bug #22868 fixed by 12cfc836. Agent must (1) author its own failing IMAP reproduction as a deliverable (/app/reproduce_bug.sh) whose contract is verifiable in both directions, (2) locate and fix the silent wrong-mailbox IMAP selection bug in a real ~200k-line C codebase without any hint of the file or the fix, (3) rebuild. The verifier runs the agent's reproduction against a pristine pre-fix binary (must fail) and the agent's rebuilt binary (must pass), force-rebuilds from source (defeats binary swapping/wrappers), runs the project's own golden regression test 804 (restored from a canonical copy so tampering is impossible), the project's own existing suite (tests 1,10,800-803,805,806), and three authored hidden cases (three case-variants, identical-name reuse, INBOX mixed-case reuse) that the upstream test does not use. Build is 1 CPU; measured build time used for build_timeout_sec.
